policy.workflowPreflightPosition: after setup-node and before Lean setup, TypeScript install, cache restoration, or native compilation; full qualification only
policy.effectiveAvailable: minimum of physical MemAvailable, process.availableMemory(), effective capacity, and each resolvable visible cgroup ancestor limit minus current usage
policy.cgroup: Resolve membership against the broadest matching visible cgroup2/memory-controller mount and visit every directory through its mount root; include v2 max/high or v1 hard/soft limits; keep raw 64-bit counter strings and clamp numeric observations to physical capacity.
policy.cgroupVisibilityLimit: Only visible hierarchy ancestors are observable. A visible root mapping with no memory.current, neither memory.max nor memory.high, and neither non-root interface cgroup.type nor cgroup.events is the explicit global-root exception. Other absent/unsupported mappings refuse with a receipt.
policy.nodeOptionsSyntax: Any quote or backslash in NODE_OPTIONS refuses before resource-flag scanning. This narrow qualification environment does not implement Node's quoted-option tokenizer; the workflow supplies no NODE_OPTIONS.

documentationForMaintainer: The preceding run exhausted the default V8 heap during the first C2 build. The retained archive contains no C2 files, so no C2 receipt or fixed point is claimed.

The next full qualification has an explicit 8192 MiB old-space budget. It starts only when the actual runner reports at least 12 GiB available after physical and visible cgroup constraints. Failure records the policy, observations and refusal; there is no dynamic heap fallback.

This is a bounded execution policy, not a proved memory fix. Reviewed admission reuse removes two whole encodings and one environment reconstruction, but one non-streaming encoding still retains substantial graphs and strings. Origins also retain additional evidence.

Each generation writes small synchronous resource checkpoints and binds the trace hash in its receipt. The last successful phase survives a fatal abort. No callback or timer changes the source-owned atomic operation, and boundary measurements do not identify its internal peak.
TypeScript 7 retains its separate existing child process and receives no new inherited heap option. No cache algorithm, provider, kernel, source grammar or conformance claim is changed.

Run the existing node --check gates and the one exact-source coherent cloud qualification after independent review. Do not add speculative reruns, GC tuning, broad tests or silently reduced resource limits.

independentReview.rootReview: Root cleared the resource design, qualify/workflow and authorized both narrow fail-closed helper refinements.
findingsResolved: Distinguish a real cgroup root from a namespace root using both CFTYPE_NOT_ON_ROOT interfaces.
Refuse quote/backslash NODE_OPTIONS forms before scanning inherited heap flags.
independentReview.reviewMethod: Pinned source inspection and exact text delta readback; no compiler, shell, local filesystem, tests or workflow execution.
